decision_scope: Source-qualified proposal reference disposition; no adapter approval

identity.maintenance: Named maintainers and dated CRAN publication; no promised active support or complete release census.

declared: Suggested fixest, testthat, covr, knitr, rmarkdown, png and stargazer; no frozen environment

target_and_uncertainty: Omitted-variable coefficient and uncertainty sensitivity for a declared regression and partial-R-squared restrictions; not a universal causal-effect certificate.
reason: Retain a transparent regression-sensitivity reference; numerical wrapper, iid covariance and endpoint contracts need explicit native qualification before an adapter.
conversion_contract: Require model identity, treatment coefficient, adjustment set, row clock, residual degrees of freedom, covariance type and exact effect units.
Preserve both partial R-squared quantities, sign/reduce direction, q, alpha, benchmark groups and multipliers; benchmark plausibility is an explicit scientific assumption.
The inspected fixest extraction forces iid covariance; refuse silently transferring clustered or heteroskedastic standard errors to this profile.
Use a declared finite regular domain and diagnose singular boundaries before computation; retain warnings and raw benchmark caps.

Compare direct numeric helpers, numeric wrapper and model dispatch. The estimate argument is accepted through ellipsis and unused in the SE helper; inspect dof versus dof-1 interval conventions before promising equivalent output.

alternatives.reason: Multiple method/conversion families and unresolved environment, rights and native behavior exceed the selected profile.
Retains source semantics if conversion, sampling law, failures and rights are qualified; process separation does not itself clear rights.
No measured operational advantage justifies reproducing dispatch, uncertainty, approximations and upgrade maintenance.
Transparent arithmetic supports conversion checks without becoming a calibrated inference service.

alternatives.route: Substitute for identification or alternative sensitivity families
alternatives.reason: Targets and assumptions differ; graph ambiguity, trend sensitivity and latent confounding are not interchangeable.

costs_to_measure: Scientific benchmark selection and independent review

owner_obligations.scientific: Target, identification, covariance and plausibility of sensitivity parameters
owner_obligations.maintainer: Pinned artifacts, conversion, dispatch tests and complete failure outputs
owner_obligations.operator: Actual delivery permissions, custody and resource budget

revisit_trigger: Complete selected environment and rights evidence plus native helper/model/boundary oracles; changed source, target, sampling law or delivery requires re-review.
limitations: Selected authenticated source and independently authored arithmetic only; no downloaded package code executes.
CRAN mirror revisions are concrete source snapshots, not a complete release-history or maintenance-service census.
Package license declarations and separately identified local GPL texts do not clear transitive dependencies, datasets or a proposed distribution.
No native adapter, finite-sample coverage, causal truth, measured bank benefit, visual review or final proposal acceptance is granted.
